The researchers show that text-image models don't automatically understand three-dimensional space. Spatial awareness has to be trained on purpose. The goal is a single model that runs both the cockpit and the driving system. stories.title: 在瑞銀，AI 技能現在是獲得工作的條件 / At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job

sources.title: 在瑞銀，AI 技能現在是獲得工作的條件 / At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job
sources.title_zh: 在瑞銀，AI 技能現在是獲得工作的條件
sources.title_en: At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job
sources.title_original: At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job
sources.summary: Swiss banking giant UBS is making AI skills a required qualification from 2027 for graduates and interns in Global Banking and Markets, with applicants having to show in interviews how they use AI to improve outcomes and efficiency. Santander is already looking for advanced AI users too, while Morgan Stanley predicts more than 200,000 banking jobs in Europe will disappear within five years. The article At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 瑞士銀行巨頭瑞銀（UBS）將 AI 技能列為 2027 年起全球銀行與市場部門畢業生和實習生的必備資格，申請人必須在面試中展示他們如何利用 AI 來改善成果與效率。桑坦德銀行（Santander）也已經在尋找具備進階 AI 能力的使用者，而摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）則預測，五年內歐洲將有超過 20 萬個銀行職位消失。「在瑞銀，AI 技能現在是獲得工作的條件」一文最先發布於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: 西雅圖時報與Newsday控告OpenAI、微軟，要求銷毀納入其新聞內容的AI模型
sources.summary: 美國媒體西雅圖時報與Newsday向紐約南區聯邦地方法院，控告OpenAI與微軟侵犯著作權，指控兩家公司未經授權使用新聞內容訓練AI，並在搜尋與生成回答時取用西雅圖時報與Newsday的報導。兩家媒體要求損害賠償、禁止被指控的侵權行為，並要求法院扣押或銷毀納入西雅圖時報與Newsday新聞內容或衍生內容的大型語言模型與訓練資料集。

Shipping alongside them are the pre-training corpus, […] The post IFM Releases K2 Horizon: Six Apache 2.0 Models From 0.9B to 375B appeared first on MarkTechPost .

IFM is the frontier lab launched by MBZUAI in May 2025. K2 Horizon is a fleet of six models: 375B-A23B, 36B-A4B, 32B, 7B, 3.7B and 0.9B. Shipping alongside them are the pre-training corpus, […] The post IFM Releases K2 Horizon: Six Apache 2.0 Models From 0.9B to 375B appeared first on MarkTechPost .
primary_item.summary_zh: 多數開源模型的發表通常只會釋出一個檢查點和基準測試表。基礎模型研究所（IFM）上週發布了規模更廣泛的成果。IFM 是由 MBZUAI 於 2025 年 5 月成立的前沿實驗室。K2 Horizon 是一系列包含六個模型的組合：375B-A23B、36B-A4B、32B、7B、3.7B 和 0.9B。與這些模型一同發布的還有預訓練語料庫，[...] The post IFM Releases K2 Horizon: Six Apache 2.0 Models From 0.9B to 375B appeared first on MarkTechPost .

stories.news_summary: IFM 於上週發布 K2 Horizon 系列，包含 375B-A23B 至 0.9B 共六款 Apache 2.0 授權模型，並同步提供預訓練語料庫。

stories.title: H Company 發布 NeoMME：一系列捨棄視覺塔與因果解碼器的 2.6 億與 8.0 億參數單塔多模態編碼器 / H Company Releases NeoMME: A Family of 260M and 800M Single-Tower Multimodal Encoders That Drop the Vision Tower and Causal Decoder

sources.title: H Company 發布 NeoMME：一系列捨棄視覺塔與因果解碼器的 2.6 億與 8.0 億參數單塔多模態編碼器 / H Company Releases NeoMME: A Family of 260M and 800M Single-Tower Multimodal Encoders That Drop the Vision Tower and Causal Decoder
sources.title_zh: H Company 發布 NeoMME：一系列捨棄視覺塔與因果解碼器的 2.6 億與 8.0 億參數單塔多模態編碼器
sources.title_en: H Company Releases NeoMME: A Family of 260M and 800M Single-Tower Multimodal Encoders That Drop the Vision Tower and Causal Decoder
sources.title_original: H Company Releases NeoMME: A Family of 260M and 800M Single-Tower Multimodal Encoders That Drop the Vision Tower and Causal Decoder
sources.summary: We look at NeoMME, a family of 260M and 800M bidirectional encoders from H Company. Unlike ColPali-style retrievers, it processes multilingual text tokens and raw 32×32 image patches in a single Transformer, with no pretrained vision tower and no causal decoder. We cover the masked discrete-diffusion pretraining objective, the dual dense and late-interaction retrieval heads, and the ViDoRe v3 results where the 260M model reaches 0.523 nDCG@10. We also break down the 255× index compression, the 51.3 pages per second indexing throughput on one L40S, and the text-retrieval gaps the authors acknowledge. The post H Company Releases NeoMME: A Family of 260M and 800M Single-Tower Multimodal Encoders That Drop the Vision Tower and Causal Decoder appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 我們來看看 NeoMME，這是一系列來自 H 公司的 2.6 億與 8.0 億參數雙向編碼器。與 ColPali 風格的檢索器不同，它在單一 Transformer 中處理多語言文字 Token 與原始 32×32 影像補丁（patches），沒有預訓練的視覺塔（vision tower），也沒有因果解碼器（causal decoder）。我們介紹了遮罩離散擴散預訓練目標、雙重密集與晚期互動檢索頭，以及 ViDoRe v3 的結果，其中 2.6 億參數模型達到了 0.523 nDCG@10。我們還剖析了 255× 的索引壓縮、在單張 L40S 上每秒 51.3 頁的索引吞吐量，以及作者承認的文字檢索差距。本文最初發布於 MarkTechPost：「H Company 發布 NeoMME：一系列捨棄視覺塔與因果解碼器的 2.6 億與 8.0 億參數單塔多模態編碼器」。

stories.title: Meta FAIR 推出 AI 研究偏好模型 (RPM)：在消耗 GPU 時數之前對 ML 實驗進行排序 / Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs): Ranking ML Experiments Before Spending GPU Hours

sources.title: Meta FAIR 推出 AI 研究偏好模型 (RPM)：在消耗 GPU 時數之前對 ML 實驗進行排序 / Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs): Ranking ML Experiments Before Spending GPU Hours
sources.title_zh: Meta FAIR 推出 AI 研究偏好模型 (RPM)：在消耗 GPU 時數之前對 ML 實驗進行排序
sources.title_en: Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs): Ranking ML Experiments Before Spending GPU Hours
sources.title_original: Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs): Ranking ML Experiments Before Spending GPU Hours
sources.summary: AI research agents can propose far more experiments than they can afford to run. Meta FAIR, Oxford and UCL introduce AI Research Preference Models — frozen LLM judges that rank 15 unexecuted candidates and execute only one. On AIRS-Bench, the average normalized score rises from 0.684 to 0.729, and the baseline's 24-hour result arrives in roughly 15 hours. The post Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs): Ranking ML Experiments Before Spending GPU Hours appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: AI 研究代理程式可以提出的實驗數量，遠遠超過它們有能力執行的數量。Meta FAIR、牛津大學和倫敦大學學院（UCL）推出了 AI 研究偏好模型（AI Research Preference Models）——透過凍結的 LLM 評審來對 15 個未執行的候選項目進行排序，並僅執行其中一個。在 AIRS-Bench 上，平均標準化分數從 0.684 提高到 0.729，而基準原本需要 24 小時才能完成的結果，現在大約 15 小時即可得出。這篇文章 Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs): Ranking ML Experiments Before Spending GPU Hours 最初發表於 MarkTechPost .

stories.title: 研究加速：OpenAI 內部觀點 / Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI

sources.title: 研究加速：OpenAI 內部觀點 / Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
sources.title_zh: 研究加速：OpenAI 內部觀點
sources.title_en: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
sources.title_original: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
sources.summary: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI Apparently today is RSI day at OpenAI, for Recursive Self-Improvement - I think it's their new AGI. Both this piece and the new essay An Alien Mind (by Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki) talk about it, and this one doesn't even bother to expand the acronym. Included are details on how OpenAI's own research team are using coding agents. Like pretty much everyone else 2026 has been the year that agentic engineering really took off at OpenAI, best illustrated by this chart: I'm intrigued at what caused that significant acceleration in AI spend per researcher in late July - my best guess is that's when internal employees gained access to the model later released as GPT-6 Astra. Tags: ai , openai , generative-ai , chatgpt , llms , coding-agents , november-2025-inflection , recursive-self-improvement
sources.summary_zh: 研究加速：OpenAI 內部觀點 顯然今天是 OpenAI 的 RSI（遞歸自我改進）日——我認為這是他們的全新 AGI。這篇文章和首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 的新文章《異質心智》（An Alien Mind）都有談到這一點，甚至連縮寫都懶得展開說明。文中包含了 OpenAI's 自己的研究團隊如何使用程式碼代理的詳細資訊。就像幾乎所有人一樣，2026 年是代理式工程（agentic engineering）在 OpenAI 真正騰飛的一年，這張圖表就是最好的證明：我很好奇是什麼原因導致了 7 月底每位研究人員的 AI 支出顯著加速——我最好的猜測是，那是內部員工獲得後來發布為 GPT-6 Astra 的模型的時間。標籤：ai, openai, generative-ai, chatgpt, llms, coding-agents, november-2025-inflection, recursive-self-improvement
